items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative meal photograph for a nutrition recipe catalog. Frango coxa sem pele is skinless roasted thigh muscle: show deboned irregular thick slices with visible fibrous cut faces, no intact drumsticks or whole thighs, no wrinkled poultry skin, only browned bare meat edges.
